subject: Re: Encord Picing
text:
Hi Steffan,

Thanks for following up!

As discussed, we’re starting small for now—large-scale curation is
currently out of scope. Over the next six months, we’re focused on targeted
annotation projects and iterating on our existing dataset.

However, beyond that, we will consider extending our usage, and I believe
the ROI in starting large scale curation work on Encord will be much
clearer at that stage. Especially if we’re already integrated with your
platform and using it for our baseline data work.And looking beyond a
one-year horizon, we expect to scale significantly and raise our Series A.
At that point, both our usage and budget will expand considerably.

I appreciate your flexibility and understand that working within our budget
constraints might be a stretch. That said, one of the challenges we face is
that we’re currently paying $15K per year with V7, which makes it difficult
to justify a significant price hike, even if we recognize that Encord is a
stronger platform with better support. Additionally, we’re in discussions
with Dataloop, which we currently prefer over V7, and it looks like they
may be able to meet our needs at around $20K.

We’d love to explore options that align with our current phase while
keeping the door open for a long-term collaboration. Let me know what could
be possible.

Best,

Mate

like to confirm!

would like more, we would have to charge for the extra dishes.

A quick change in our menu-we no longer offer the Roasted Chicken Breast,

Let me know what you think!
